question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Interupt" is the incorrect spelling of the word. The correct spelling is **"interrupt"**.
 
• The word **"interrupt"** means to stop the continuous progress of an activity or process; to break the continuity. (बाधित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apparently** (प्रकट रूप से): As far as one knows or can see.

 
 
• **Example:** Apparently, she didn't notice the mistake in the report.
 
 
 
• **Committee** (समिति): A group of people appointed for a specific function.
 
 
• **Example:** The committee will meet tomorrow to discuss the new project.
 
 
 
• **Foreign** (विदेशी): From or in a country that is not one's own.
 
 
• **Example:** He enjoys learning about foreign cultures.
